rationale: No configured random loss does not imply zero finite-queue congestion loss. Reassembly expiry may follow missing QUIC datagrams while TCP retransmits to exact application completion. Rejecting all such sessions would hide legitimate byte/time/CPU costs.
accepted_and_reported: Replay/order counters retained in raw and delivery diagnostics
still_required: Exact application bytes, lengths and digest receipts
Zero capture-kernel drops and complete parsed packet count
No reassembly capacity exhaustion: separately labeled resource limitation
Measured profile calibration within preregistered tolerance
Drained qdisc queue, unchanged host routes and frozen identities
